args.summary: Hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to replace unhealthy v2.3.1 (18% error rate). Deployment rolled out successfully. This incident tracks the change and service health following the hotfix.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Verified pre-deploy state**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all three production regions, unhealthy with an 18% error rate.
2. **Deployed hotfix v2.3.2**: Since v2.3.2 had never run in production, the deploy was routed for change-manager approval per policy — it was approved and rolled out to us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
3. **Opened incident INC-0001 (SEV3)**: Recorded the hotfix deployment and its context (replacing unhealthy v2.3.1); the on-call engineer was paged.
4. **Confirmed post-deploy health**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.2 across all regions with an error rate of 0.002% (down from 18%).
